scientific_integrity: An exact field-independent rank stratification proves the entire element-indexed inner derivation polynomial. Full enumeration at q=2,3 is supporting verification; the case analysis is the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the four-element diamond incidence algebra is classified. No rank spectra of general height-three posets, arbitrary outer derivations, or conjugacy classes are asserted. Historical originality is best of knowledge; general structural-matrix centralizer enumerators may overlap.
title: The adjoint-rank polynomial of the four-element diamond incidence algebra
